summary: Discover effective reserve management and cross-border payment techniques with our tailored training programs. Empower your financial career today!
lede: Reserve management and cross-border payment operations connect liquidity decisions with payment execution, settlement, and oversight. This course is for professionals in treasury, reserves, payment operations, compliance, and settlement who need to manage liquidity and control cross-border transaction flows. Participants learn to assess liquidity and currency exposure, map payment controls and settlement touchpoints, and use risk registers and treasury reporting to support daily oversight.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work in reserves, treasury, payment operations, compliance, and settlement oversight, and who need practical control over liquidity, FX, and cross-border transaction flows.
prerequisites: You should bring a working understanding of treasury, banking operations, or payment systems concepts. A laptop is recommended for workshop exercises, and prior exposure to FX, liquidity reporting, or reserve policy documents will help you get more from the case work.
